To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1. the performance of EWMA charts is not affected by the presence of autocorrelation in the time series; 2. the performance of the Shewhat and CUSUM scheme is strongly affected by the autocorrelation in time series.
the EWMA control chart is a powerful tool for detecting changes in a time series and that it is also useful to detect changes in the parameters of a time series.
the EWMA chart is a powerful tool for monitoring the mean and the variance of a process.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following topics: 1. Construction of time series models for the control of a process, 2. The use of time series models in the construction of control charts, 3. The use of control charts for the monitoring of a time series.

the following topics:
* The development of EWMA charts for time series, based on the assumption that the observations are independent, identically distributed random variables.
the following questions: (1) How to use time series model for control chart construction? (2) How to use the time series model for the detection of the assignable causes?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the EWMA control chart is the best choice for monitoring a process with a time series structure, if one wants to use the Shewhart control chart as a reference.
the performance of control charts depends on the underlying time series.
autocorrelation has to be taken into account when designing a control chart for a time series.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the EWMA chart has a good performance in terms of average run length for time series with a small amount of autocorrelation.
we have developed the first time series models which are suitable for the construction of control charts.
the EWMA chart is the best choice in case of autocorrelated data.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of time series models is not only justified, but also necessary for a proper control chart design.
the EWMA chart can be used as an effective control chart in the presence of autocorrelation.
it is possible to construct EWMA charts that have good performance in terms of ARL when the underlying observations are not independent.
